  - text: שיר המעלות — A Song of Ascents When the Lord returned the captivity of Zion, we were like dreamers. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַזָּן אֶת הַכֹּל — Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who nourishes the entire world with His goodness, with grace, with kindness and with mercy. נוֹדֶה לְּךָ — We thank You, Lord our God, for having given our ancestors as heritage a precious, good and spacious land. רַחֵם נָא — Have mercy, Lord our God, on Israel Your people, on Jerusalem Your city. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, בּוֹנֵה בְרַחֲמָיו יְרוּשָׁלָיִם, אָמֵן. הָרַחֲמָן הוּא יִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד — May the Merciful One reign over us forever and ever. עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו — May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say Amen.
